theme_strategy.rationale: HVAC control dashboards benefit from high contrast and a premium 'Command Center' feel. Dark mode with strict color coding (Orange/Red for heating, Blue for cooling) maximizes readability and prevents visual fatigue for users checking statuses frequently.
theme_strategy.archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Grid Borders Technical look

rules: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk, Open Sans.
Headings (Size > 32px) MUST use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Overlines / Labels MUST be Uppercase, tiny, and have wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
DO NOT use text larger than text-6xl for maximum size.
typography.installation: Add fonts via Google Fonts in index.html or import directly in CSS.

rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint greys slightly (e.g. zinc or slate from Tailwind).
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or surfaces that have content under them. Use solid #121212 or high-opacity backdrop blur (e.g. bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl).
Hover states must explicitly set text color.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors with 1px border highlights for depth.

grid_and_layout.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton with border-collapse and border-border/40. No soft shadows. Use sharp edges or max 8px radius.
rules: High Density Grid for Zone Dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.

components_and_features.master_thermostat: Position as a prominent sticky header or top hero widget. Must include Mode toggle (Chaud / Froid) and Global System Power (Allumer / Eteindre).
components_and_features.zone_dashboard: Grid of modular tiles. Each tile represents a zone (e.g., Salon, Chambre 1). Must show current temperature prominently, target setpoint, and damper state (Registre: Ouvert/Fermé).
components_and_features.temperature_control: Use +/- buttons (up/down). DO NOT use sliders for precision control. Stepping by 0.5 degrees is ideal.
components_and_features.hourly_scheduling: Use Tabs for Days, and an Accordion or custom list for time slots (Plages horaires).
components_and_features.device_list: Synced list from SmartLife (mocked). Use Scroll Area and Switch to toggle active devices.
shadcn_overrides: Tabs: Override fixed h-9 to h-auto.
Card: Remove drop-shadows, use flat bg with 1px borders.
Switch: Customize colors to match the Heating/Cooling states.

rules: Use specific transitions (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease), NOT transition: all.
Add hover states (background shift, border color shift) and active states (scale-95) to all interactive elements.

icons.usage: Use Phosphor icons with Duotone or Regular weights for a technical look.

rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='zone-1-temp-up').
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default.
Use aria-hidden='true' for purely decorative elements.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable. The project uses .js/.jsx extensions. Share guidelines and write files strictly keeping this in mind.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
No authentication. Mock/simulated data first. All text MUST be in French.
